defs.def: a place where bread and cakes are made and/or sold 面包（糕饼）店；面包（糕饼）烘房；面包厂

ex.s: Butcher shops, greengrocers, bakeries, and cheese shops line the town square.
ex.t: 肉铺、果蔬店、面包店和奶酪店排列在小镇广场周围。

ex.s: Now it’s a tourist area with lots of shops, restaurants, and bakeries.
ex.t: 如今这里成了旅游区，遍布商店、餐厅和面包店。

ex.s: Bakeries, fast-food joints, butcher shops, cafes, and restaurants everywhere provide some of the premier food experiences in the world.
ex.t: 各地的面包店、快餐店、肉铺、咖啡馆和餐厅，提供了世界上一些顶级的饮食体验。

ex.s: I first tried it about two years ago, when I visited a bakery with my parents.
ex.t: 我大约两年前第一次尝试它，那时我和父母去了一家面包店。
